definitions.explanation: An activity done to refresh one's mood or relieve stress. Implies doing something enjoyable to take one's mind off worries.

examples.japanese: {気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go shopping as a diversion.

examples.japanese: {気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched a movie to take my mind off things.

examples.japanese: ⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たまったら、{気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{行|い}こう→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: When stress builds up, let's go on a trip for a change of pace.

notes:
{気晴|きば}らし refers to doing something enjoyable to refresh one's mood or relieve stress. It implies a deliberate change of activity to escape worries.

FORMS:
⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧ (spirit, mood) + {晴|は}らし (clearing away). Literally "clearing the mood."

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something as a diversion
- {気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to serve as a diversion
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{気晴|きば}らしだ: it's a good change of pace
- {気晴|きば}らし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out for a change of pace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{息抜|いきぬ}き→息抜き：16698_ikinuki⟧: a breather (emphasis on resting from work)
- ⟦{暇|ひま}つぶし→暇つぶし：16684_himatsubushi⟧: killing time (casual, implies boredom)
- ⟦{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}→気分転換：08691_kibuntenkan⟧: change of mood (more neutral/formal)
- ⟦{娯楽|ごらく}→娯楽：00074_goraku⟧: entertainment, recreation (broader term)
- ⟦リフレッシュ→リフレッシュ：11261_rifuresshu⟧: refreshing oneself (loanword)
